names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 23 октября ст. ст., «Николай (Архангельский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The line declines the name and gives it without the surname, as «Сщмчч. ... Николая ... пресвитеров».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Николая , Владимира , Александра , Николая , Емилиана и Созонта пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: He is the fourth of the six and the second of the two men called Николай on it, told from the first by surname and not by the line, which gives neither. The link behind his place says иерей, the grade the line gives all six together as пресвитеров, so the office and the types agree here. His name page carries no life.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the company line it names him in on 23 октября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page for him and gives no day.
